**From PageRank to the vision stack**

> 从 PageRank 到视觉栈

## Why it matters (为何重要)

Stanford's CS culture turns research directly into infrastructure and into the lecture notes the world learns from.

> 斯坦福的 CS 文化把研究直接变成基础设施，也变成全世界学习的讲义。

## Background (背景)

Founded in 1885 by Leland and Jane Stanford as a memorial to their son, the university opened on 1 October 1891. Its location in Silicon Valley shaped a department closely tied to industry.

> 斯坦福大学由 Leland 与 Jane Stanford 于 1885 年创办以纪念他们的儿子，1891 年 10 月 1 日开学。位于硅谷的地理位置塑造了它与产业界紧密相连的计算机系。

## People (人物)

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| Sergey Brin | Stanford graduate students who co-developed PageRank and co-founded Google in 1998 |
| Fei-Fei Li | Stanford professor and lead instructor of CS231n |
| Andrew Ng | Stanford adjunct professor and longtime instructor of CS229 |

> **Larry Page** 与 **Sergey Brin** — 斯坦福研究生，共同开发 PageRank 并于 1998 年创办 Google。**李飞飞** — 斯坦福教授，CS231n 主讲。**Andrew Ng** — 斯坦福兼职教授，长期主讲 CS229。

|:--|:--|

| CS161 | Design and Analysis of Algorithms |

> CS106A 编程方法学 · CS161 算法设计与分析 · CS107 编程范式 · CS229 机器学习 · CS231n 计算机视觉深度学习。

## In this book (本书收录)

- [002](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/002-stanford-cs144-tcp) — TCP (CS144)
- [007](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/007-stanford-cs143-compiler) — Compiler (CS143)

- [010](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/010-stanford-cs248-raytracer) — Raytracer (CS248)

- [015](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/015-stanford-cs106b-boggle) — Boggle (CS106B)

**From CS144's TCP to CS231n's neural networks, the Stanford projects here trace the path from networks to AI that the department itself helped define.**

> 从 CS144 的 TCP 到 CS231n 的神经网络，本书的斯坦福项目复刻了这条从网络到 AI 的路径——这条路径正是该系参与定义的。
